scenarios.name: Cancel a later edit after applying a custom command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Part Tools custom panel is initially empty
the ribbon customization dialog is open
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel and clicks "Apply"
the User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
the user adds "3D Annotations" to the custom panel and clicks "Cancel"
the User Commands panel remains visible
the Part Tools custom panel contains "2D Sketches"
"3D Annotations" is available in the source list
